HEEWON STYLE — a KOREAN WEBTOON character-introduction splash used as a movie still, the look of a dramatic manhwa cover. SAME FILM STOCK every still in this feast: BOLD THICK digital-ink line (heavy tapered black contour around every silhouette, hair mass and fold), saturated crimson and ochre silk, wet skin, dark steam, creamy round lamp bokeh, shallow DOF, painted splash, paper grain. Night-dusk ground: crushed dark steam and stone, the figures the saturated inked thing. NOT a fine-line architectural illustration. NOT ukiyo-e. NOT a pale tourist onsen postcard. NOT a circular bath catalog. NOT a Japanese ryokan. NOT thin-line historical diagram. NOT photoreal. NOT a European oil portrait. NOT live-action. NOT 3D. NOT pores. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. A new verb pose, never a standing fashion plate. No text. No watermark.
